Oneliner

Replicate ATMS satellite and measure atmospheric temperature and moisture.
Description

12U satellite with 22 channels to replicate ATMS (Advanced Technology Microwave Sounder). High-performance, radiation tolerant design; >two-year mission life. Retrieve profiles of atmospheric temperature and moisture.
